reason: The sachet idea suits me since I forget pills at home and travel a lot, but $25 to $30 a month for magnesium is too much on my budget. I can get a bottle at the drugstore for a lot less and keep it in my gym bag.
objection: I make $26k a year and $29.99 a month for one supplement is real money for me. And it's still two capsules to swallow every day.
would_change_my_mind: A price around $15 a box, or a cheap small trial box to see if it actually helps me sleep before paying for 30 days.
